summary: Complaints centre on erratic power (10 to 12 hours of cuts a day, repeated tripping, unannounced outages), waterlogging in the Dibai market and an unfinished bypass; the only verified appreciation is a quick restoration after a sub-station VCB fire, and the other positives are thin and flagged.

positives.english: Power came back in about three hours after the VCB fire
positives.hindi: वीसीबी जली तो भी करीब तीन घंटे में बिजली लौट आई
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (30 Jun 2026): fire in a VCB machine at the 132 kV Bhimpur sub-station cut power to Dibai homes around 10:24 PM on the Monday night; supply was restored in about three hours once the fault was fixed. Consumers had faced low voltage, tripping and undeclared cuts for the three days before it

positives.english: Sugar mills have sent the full cane payment into farmers' accounts
positives.hindi: चीनी मिलों ने गन्ने का पूरा पैसा किसानों के खाते में भेज दिया
positives.basis: District-level, not Dibai-specific: ChiniMandi (8 Jul 2026) says the four Bulandshahr mills of the 2025-26 season (named as Sabitgarh, Anamika at Agauta, Wave at Bulandshahr, Di Kisan at Anupshahr) have sent 100% of the payment for cane bought to farmers' bank accounts, total Rs 1,09,209.12 lakh. Dibai is not mentioned in the article

positives.english: *There is a 100-bed government hospital in Dibai
positives.hindi: *डिबाई में 100 बेड का सरकारी अस्पताल है
positives.basis: Inference: a 2026 Amar Ujala district report surfaced in search (not opened, so no URL is cited) names the 100-bed Rajkiya Chikitsalaya Dibai among government hospitals in Bulandshahr. It is a facility, not a verified benefit delivered to voters. Field check needed

positives.english: *Farmers can sell their crop at the Dibai mandi
positives.hindi: *डिबाई की मंडी में किसान अपनी फसल बेच पाते हैं
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (2 Sep 2026) names Mandi Hardev as a waterlogged spot in Dibai, which implies a functioning mandi there; no source found on crop sales or prices at Dibai mandi this round. Field check needed

positives.english: *Government offices are close by since Dibai is a tehsil headquarters
positives.hindi: *डिबाई तहसील होने से सरकारी दफ्तर पास में हैं
positives.basis: Inference: the Wikipedia Debai Assembly constituency page (fetched) says the extent is Debai Tehsil, so the tehsil office is local. No source found on a specific service or benefit delivered this round, so this is weak and should be replaced after a field check

negatives.english: Power is cut for 10 to 12 hours a day in Dibai
negatives.hindi: डिबाई में रोज़ 10 से 12 घंटे बिजली कटती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (13 Jul 2026): a table of daily average outage hours gives Dibai as 10 से 12 घंटे, the same as Shikarpur; the table sits in a report on a protest in Bulandshahr city (Manasarovar Colony), and the article also reports 8 to 10 hours of daily cuts in most villages. Chief Engineer Sanjeev Kumar blamed load in summer. Dibai is a town named after the AC, so it counts as inside the AC

negatives.english: Market shops in Dibai flood when it rains
negatives.hindi: डिबाई में बारिश हुई तो बाजार और दुकानों में पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (2 Sep 2026): after about 45 minutes of heavy rain, Mahadev Chauraha, Paith Chauraha, Holi Gate and Bada Bazar had two to three feet of water, and Railway Road shops were flooded. Councillors said the market still has no relief from waterlogging and the matter was raised with the EO and the chairperson. No official response quoted

negatives.english: Power trips and goes off without notice in Dibai
negatives.hindi: डिबाई में बार-बार ट्रिपिंग और बिना बताए बिजली कटौती से परेशानी
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (1 Jul 2026): residents of Dibai faced unannounced cuts and repeated tripping for 10 days; flour mills could not grind wheat and children's studies were affected. Trader representative Deepak Agarwal gave a memorandum to XEN Rahul Ratn Bodhi seeking advance notice of cuts. XEN said transformer overloading causes it. The article also says work is ongoing on the first and second feeders

negatives.english: Dibai bypass is still unfinished and highway jams continue
negatives.hindi: डिबाई का बाईपास अधूरा पड़ा है और हाईवे पर जाम लगता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (14 May 2025, district-level plan article): the lead says the incomplete bypass in Dibai will be completed, and a 6.80 km Dibai bypass costing Rs 45.50 crore is only a proposal sent for approval, with no work reported as complete. Amar Ujala (2 Sep 2026) reports people stuck in highway jams in Dibai during the rain. No 2026 status report on the bypass was found, so the 'still unfinished' part rests on the 2025 article

negatives.english: Garbage piles up on the streets in the morning in towns like Dibai
negatives.hindi: सुबह सड़कों पर कचरे के ढेर लगे मिलते हैं
negatives.basis: District-level: Amar Ujala (1 Oct 2026) lists the Dibai nagar palika among Bulandshahr-district bodies, and the sentence says garbage heaps are seen on the streets in the morning. The article gives no Dibai-specific figure, so Dibai is named only inside a district list and this is not counted as AC-specific

notes: Identity confirmed: Wikipedia list gives Constituency No. 68 Debai, Bulandshahr district, reservation None, and neighbours 67 Anupshahr and 69 Shikarpur. Wikipedia Debai AC page says the extent is Debai Tehsil plus units from the Anupshahar KC (Bagsara, Bibiyana, Mau, Dubka, Suratgarh urf Lodhai, Rajour); those units are not individually confirmed as in Dibai's extent by the page's wording beyond that list, so they were not used. Dibai town is the namesake and counts as inside the AC. Power evidence is strong and local (Amar Ujala, May to Jul 2026), but the 1 Jul and 13 Jul 2026 articles report residents' accounts and official explanations only, not verified outage logs. The Dibai bypass status after May 2025 and any Dibai-specific road, water or sanitation project were not found in 2026 sources. Positives 3 to 5 are inferences with no cited source, and a field check should replace them. The 100-bed hospital and digital X-ray leads came from search snippets whose URLs did not match their titles, so they were not cited. The 15-hour supply and inverter report was not found. Chief Engineer Sanjeev Kumar and XEN Rahul Ratn Bodhi are the officials quoted for power.
